meta.name: cfo-advisor
meta.description: Financial leadership for startups and scaling companies. Financial modeling, unit economics, fundraising strategy, cash management, and board financial packages. Use when building financial models, analyzing unit economics, planning fundraising, managing cash runway, preparing board materials, or when user mentions CFO, burn rate, runway, fundraising, unit economics, LTV, CAC, term sheets, or financial strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为初创公司提供财务建模与融资策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是初创公司创始人或CFO，需要财务模型和融资支持。
copy.tagline_en: Provide financial modeling and fundraising strategy for startups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a startup founder or CFO needing financial models and fundraising support.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演创业公司CFO，帮你做财务模型、分析单位经济、规划融资、管理现金流、准备董事会材料，并主动预警财务风险。
howto.when: 当你提到CFO、烧钱率、跑道、融资、单位经济、LTV、CAC、条款清单等关键词，或要求做财务模型、分析单位经济、规划融资、管理现金流、准备董事会材料时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下我们公司的单位经济，按渠道分CAC和LTV。
我们当前烧钱率是多少？做三个场景的跑道预测。
准备融资材料，包括指标、财务数据和股权结构表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a startup CFO, helping with financial modeling, unit economics analysis, fundraising strategy, cash management, board materials preparation, and proactively flagging financial risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention CFO, burn rate, runway, fundraising, unit economics, LTV, CAC, term sheets, etc., or ask to build financial models, analyze unit economics, plan fundraising, manage cash, or prepare board materials.

say_en.text: Analyze our unit economics by channel for CAC and LTV.
What's our current burn rate? Run three-scenario runway projections.
say_en.note: Claude runs burn rate calculator, generates base/bull/bear runway models.

say_en.text: Prepare fundraising materials including metrics, financials, and cap table.
